label: ISO 9004:2018 Quality of an organization — guidance to achieve sustained success
notice: Clause numbers and titles are used for mapping only. Summaries are Continuum's own wording, not ISO text. Verify against your licensed copy of the standard.

obligations.title: Quality of an organization
obligations.summary: Judge quality by how well the organization meets the needs of its interested parties over time.

obligations.title: Managing for sustained success
obligations.summary: Balance short- and long-term needs to keep the organization successful.

obligations.title: Context — general
obligations.summary: Understand context as the basis for strategy and sustained success.

obligations.title: Relevant interested parties
obligations.summary: Identify the parties that matter, what they need, and how the relationship benefits both sides.

obligations.title: External and internal issues
obligations.summary: Track the issues inside and outside the organization that can help or hinder its goals.

obligations.title: Identity — general
obligations.summary: Define what the organization is and stands for as the anchor for decisions.

obligations.title: Mission, vision, values and culture
obligations.summary: Keep mission, vision, values and culture explicit, shared and consistent with behaviour.

obligations.title: Leadership — general
obligations.summary: Leaders create unity of purpose and the conditions for people to engage.

obligations.title: Policy and strategy
obligations.summary: Turn identity into a policy and strategy that are deployed and reviewed.

obligations.title: Objectives
obligations.summary: Set objectives at each level that follow from the strategy and can be measured.

obligations.title: Communication
obligations.summary: Communicate strategy and objectives so people understand their part.

obligations.title: Process management — general
obligations.summary: Manage activities as interrelated processes to get consistent, predictable results.

obligations.title: Determination of processes
obligations.summary: Determine the processes needed, how they interact and what they must deliver.

obligations.title: Responsibility and authority relating to processes
obligations.summary: Give each process an accountable owner with the authority to manage it.

obligations.title: Managing processes
obligations.summary: Plan, run, measure and improve processes, managing their interactions and risks.

obligations.title: Resource management — general
obligations.summary: Plan and provide the resources needed for sustained success.

obligations.title: People
obligations.summary: Engage, develop and empower people, and recognise their contribution.

obligations.title: Organizational knowledge
obligations.summary: Capture, share and protect the knowledge the organization depends on.

obligations.title: Technology
obligations.summary: Evaluate and adopt technology that improves performance.

obligations.title: Infrastructure and work environment
obligations.summary: Provide and maintain infrastructure and a work environment that support the work.

obligations.title: Externally provided resources
obligations.summary: Manage suppliers and partners as part of the value chain.

obligations.title: Natural resources
obligations.summary: Use natural resources responsibly and with an eye on future availability.

obligations.title: Performance analysis — general
obligations.summary: Monitor, measure, analyse and evaluate performance to inform decisions.

obligations.title: Performance indicators
obligations.summary: Choose indicators that show progress against objectives and strategy.

obligations.title: Performance analysis
obligations.summary: Analyse indicator data to find trends, causes and opportunities.

obligations.title: Performance evaluation
obligations.summary: Evaluate results against objectives and benchmarks to judge progress.

obligations.title: Internal audit
obligations.summary: Use internal audits to check effectiveness and find improvement opportunities.

obligations.title: Self-assessment
obligations.summary: Assess maturity regularly against the five-level scale to set improvement priorities.

obligations.title: Reviews
obligations.summary: Review performance and context at planned intervals and decide what to change.

obligations.title: Improvement, learning and innovation — general
obligations.summary: Treat improvement, learning and innovation as interdependent drivers of success.

obligations.title: Improvement
obligations.summary: Improve processes, products and the organization in a structured way.

obligations.title: Learning
obligations.summary: Learn from successes, failures and others, and turn it into practice.

obligations.title: Innovation
obligations.summary: Encourage and manage innovation in products, processes and the organization.
